Home Stews About

Farmhouse White Bean Stew

This invented stew feeds 6 people and keeps well for three days.

Ingredients

  • 500 g dried white beans
  • 2 large carrots, diced
  • 1 onion, chopped
  • 4 cloves garlic
  • 3 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 bay leaf
  • salt to taste

Method

  1. Soak the beans in cold water overnight, then drain them.
  2. Fry the onion, carrots and garlic in the oil for ten minutes.
  3. Add the beans, the bay leaf and two litres of water.
  4. Simmer for two hours, until the beans are soft.
  5. Season with salt at the end and serve with bread.

Farmhouse White Bean Stew (printable card)

Serves 6.

Ingredients

  • 500 g dried white beans
  • 2 large carrots, diced
  • 1 onion, chopped
  • 4 cloves garlic
  • 3 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 bay leaf
  • salt to taste

Method

  1. Soak the beans in cold water overnight, then drain them.
  2. Fry the onion, carrots and garlic in the oil for ten minutes.
  3. Add the beans, the bay leaf and two litres of water.
  4. Simmer for two hours, until the beans are soft.
  5. Season with salt at the end and serve with bread.
